Photograph of the complete white-border [[Son Of Skywalker (Revised)]] card face, cropped from the [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 PSA collector gallery] [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/179117643/qARmcotEKkCgVwV4vP6iuw.jpg front photograph]. The pictured physical card is labeled Dagobah Revised Unlimited. The card was produced by [[Decipher]]; the source photograph is published in StarWarsCollector_#1’s PSA Set Registry gallery. The gallery label is not used to establish a first publication date.

== Source and preparation ==
The full 1446 × 2400-pixel JPEG was obtained directly from the public image URL. Its SHA256 is <code style="white-space:normal; overflow-wrap:anywhere;">7b4b7058df9929085e3223f62daf0bce19c5100b00737dbe7bddfd7c10bb19a1</code> (709885 bytes).

Memory Core ChatGPT extracted rectangle (156, 648)–(1286, 2220), retaining the entire photographed card, its white edges and a narrow surrounding holder margin. The 1130 × 1572-pixel crop was downsampled to 350 × 487 pixels with Lanczos resampling and saved as PNG. No border recoloring, perspective reconstruction, printed-word replacement or generative redraw was performed. This is a photographic crop, not a reconstructed facsimile or publisher image.

The physical face reads “anything he pilots” and “during your deploy phase”. Its complete game text is transcribed on the card article.
